Name: 1 in 10000 Chance for Skeleton Jumpscare Every Second
Author: PredatedElk6
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=4]💀[/size][i] [b][color=#cc4125][size=4]What is this all about?![/size][/color][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Verdana][size=2]For my second jumpscare mod, I decided to port [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/balatro/mods/808]1 in 10000 Chance for Skeleton Jumpscare Every Second[/url][/b] to Stardew Valley. Let's see if Pelican Town can handle the chaos.[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][b][color=#6aa84f]1 in 10000 Chance for Skeleton Jumpscare Every Second[/color], [/b]this mod adds a [b]1/10000 chance every second[/b] of triggering a Skeleton jumpscare during gameplay;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]A tiny chance of chaos[/b][/color], because apparently farming sims still weren’t stressful enough on their own.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][i][color=#ffff00][b]⚠️ Disclaimer:[/b][/color] [/i][size=2]I won't be responsible for any scared chickens, dropped crops, or startled farmers. Use at your own risk.[/size][/font]

[font=Verdana][size=4]🔨 [/size][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]How to install and use[/b][/size][/color][/font][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][size=2]Be sure to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed. You can check the wiki if you don't know how to do it;[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][size=2]Extract the [color=#cccccc].zip[/color] file into the following path: [color=#cccccc]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/color];[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][size=2]Launch the game, load your save, and... good luck.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6d9eeb][b]Want to customize your experience?[/b] 🤔[/color]
If you want to change how the mod behaves, go to [color=#cccccc]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\1 in 10000 Chance for Skeleton Jumpscare Every Second[/color] and edit the [color=#cccccc]config.json[/color] file to your liking:[/size][/font]

[code]
"IntervalSeconds": 1,
"ActivationChance": 10000,
"JumpscareVolume": 1.0,
"ManualTrigger": "F8"[/code][font=Verdana]
[font=Verdana][color=#e69138][size=4][b]🌾 Credits and Thanks:[/b][/size][/color][/font][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][b]Inspired by:[/b] the tModLoader mod of the same name by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mrpejoflan][b]mrpejo[/b][/url];[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ohmydude][b]ohmydude[/b][/url][b], [/b]for suggesting the addition of a configurable manual trigger keybind and helping improve the mod; [/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][b]Skeleton jumpscare concept:[/b] a classic horror-style visual gag adapted into Stardew Valley;[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][font=Verdana][b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who enjoys absurdly low odds and unnecessary panic.[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana]
[font=Verdana][i][b]♤ ♧ Enjoy the chaos and let the jumpscare decide your fate! ♡ ♢[/b][/i][/font][/font]
